notes.note: Tab of the DNS sub-navigation that leads to the blocking view.
Title of the blocking page and its entry in the browser tab.

segment.source: The home view of the query log and the block lists: what was asked, what was blocked and by whom
segment.target: Startvyn för frågeloggen och blocklistorna: vad som frågades, vad som blockerades och av vem

notes.note: Accessible name of the choice between 24 hours and 7 days.
Line under the window choice; {from} and {until} are date and time.
Shown for the 7 days window when the log keeps fewer days.

segment.source: {days, plural, =0 {The log keeps no full day, so this window covers less than it says.} one {The log keeps # day, so this window covers only that day.} other {The log keeps # days, so this window covers only those days.}}
segment.target: {days, plural, =0 {Loggen sparar inget helt dygn, så det här fönstret täcker mindre än det säger.} one {Loggen sparar # dag, så det här fönstret täcker bara den dagen.} other {Loggen sparar # dagar, så det här fönstret täcker bara de dagarna.}}

segment.source: The log holds more queries in this window than one read looks at, so the figures cover the newest part of the log.
segment.target: Loggen innehåller fler frågor i det här fönstret än en läsning tittar på, så siffrorna gäller den senaste delen av loggen.

segment.source: One query in {sample} is logged, so the figures count the logged queries.
segment.target: En fråga av {sample} loggas, så siffrorna räknar de loggade frågorna.

notes.note: Heading, read by screen readers, of the card with the pause.
{time} is a time, or a date and time when the pause ends on another day.
Remaining time of a timed pause; {left} is a duration such as 4 min.

segment.source: While paused no block list blocks a name. Allow lists, exemptions and RPZ zones apply as before, and a restart of the node ends the pause.
segment.target: Medan pausen gäller blockerar ingen blocklista något namn. Tillåtlistor, undantag och RPZ-zoner gäller som förut, och en omstart av noden avslutar pausen.

notes.note: Label in front of the pause buttons.
Accessible name of the group of pause buttons.
Button that ends the pause of the block lists.

segment.source: {window, select, 7d {In the last 7 days} other {In the last 24 hours}}

notes.note: {share} is a percentage.

segment.source: {mode, select, address {Distinct addresses} hidden {The log keeps no client} other {A pseudonym counts once per day}}
segment.target: {mode, select, address {Skilda adresser} hidden {Loggen sparar ingen klient} other {En pseudonym räknas en gång per dygn}}

notes.note: Accessible name of the bar chart.

segment.source: Queries per hour, the blocked part marked
segment.target: Frågor per timme, den blockerade delen markerad

notes.note: Legend of the bar chart.
Legend of the bar chart.
Accessible name and tooltip of one bar; {time} is the start of the hour.

segment.source: {time}: {queries, plural, one {# query} other {# queries}}, {blocked} blocked
segment.target: {time}: {queries, plural, one {# fråga} other {# frågor}}, {blocked} blockerade

notes.note: Link to the block lists page.

segment.source: No list blocked a query in this window.
segment.target: Ingen lista blockerade någon fråga i det här fönstret.

notes.note: Next to the identifier of a block list that no longer exists.

segment.target: Andel av den mest aktiva listan

notes.note: Column with the DNS name IPAM records for the client address.

segment.source: The clients that asked most often
The log keeps a pseudonym instead of the address, one per client and day, so a client that asks on several days counts once per day.
segment.target: Loggen sparar en pseudonym i stället för adressen, en per klient och dygn, så en klient som frågar flera dagar räknas en gång per dygn.

segment.source: The log keeps no client, so no client can be named.
segment.target: Loggen sparar ingen klient, så ingen klient kan namnges.
Ingen klient i det här fönstret.

notes.note: Shown in place of a client the log does not show to the person.

segment.source: The log keeps no client, or the address is shown only to those who may update the node.
segment.target: Loggen sparar ingen klient, eller så visas adressen bara för dem som får uppdatera noden.

segment.source: The newest queries a block list blocked
segment.target: De senaste frågor som en blocklista blockerade

segment.source: No query was blocked in this window.
segment.target: Ingen fråga blockerades i det här fönstret.

notes.note: Button that adds the name of a blocked query to an allow list.
Accessible name of the Allow button of one row.

segment.source: Allow {name} and the names under it

notes.note: {list} is the name of the allow list.

segment.source: Added to the list {list}; the list is compiled now
segment.target: Tillagd i listan {list}; listan kompileras nu

segment.source: These figures are counted from the node's query log, which is off. Set enabled = true in the section [dns.log] of tenko.toml and restart the node to turn it on; the DNS settings show what the node uses now.
segment.target: De här siffrorna räknas fram ur nodens frågelogg, som är av. Sätt enabled = true i avsnittet [dns.log] i tenko.toml och starta om noden för att slå på den; DNS-inställningarna visar vad noden använder nu.

segment.source: Client groups with their own lists, and the ABP and regular expression rule syntax, are the next step. They are not built yet.
segment.target: Klientgrupper med egna listor samt regelsyntaxen ABP och reguljära uttryck är nästa steg. De är inte byggda än.

segment.source: The node's query log is off, so there are no figures. Set enabled = true in [dns.log] in tenko.toml.
segment.target: Nodens frågelogg är av, så det finns inga siffror. Sätt enabled = true i [dns.log] i tenko.toml.
